definitions.gloss: ten people; a group of ten
definitions.explanation: Ten as a count of people. Uses {人|にん}, the standard counter for people, attached to {十|じゅう} (ten). Note: 1 person is {一人|ひとり} and 2 people is {二人|ふたり} (irregular), but 3 onward use ~{人|にん}.

examples.japanese: {十|じゅう}{人|にん}{集|あつ}まった。
{予約|よやく}は{十|じゅう}{人|にん}{分|ぶん}{お願|ねが}いします。
このクラスには{留学|りゅうがく}{生|せい}が{十|じゅう}{人|にん}いて、それぞれの{国|くに}から{来|き}ている。
examples.english: There are ten exchange students in this class, each from a different country.

notes:
Counting form for ten people using the standard counter {人|にん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}いる: there are ten people
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}{集|あつ}まる: ten people gather
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}{分|ぶん}: enough for ten people; ten people's portion
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}{中|ちゅう}{九|きゅう}{人|にん}: nine out of ten (people)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{十|じゅう}{人|にん}{十|と}{色|いろ} (じゅうにんといろ) — 'ten people, ten colors', meaning everyone is different / to each their own.

RELATED WORDS:
- {一人|ひとり}: one person (irregular)
- {二人|ふたり}: two people (irregular)
- {三人|さんにん}: three people
- {何人|なんにん}: how many people
